ItemID: NA; Title: Big Hits of the 80's; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad decade compilation does not connect clearly to the blues and roots albums I have been playing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Corazon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: If this is Santana's album, its guitar focus appeals to my interest in Clapton and Hendrix; I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles 1967 1970; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The later Beatles fit my interest in classic rock, but I am not choosing a compilation this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The artist fits my taste, but the listing does not make the specific release clear enough to choose.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist, I cannot tell whether this collection interests me.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to expect the blues or roots sound I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lb - Kill The Lights; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Blown Away suggests some country interest, but this listing does not give me a strong enough connection to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Patsy Cline's Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic country has some appeal given my interest in Blown Away, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Norah Jones Day Breaks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Her relaxed, soulful sound could suit my interest in Memphis, but I would prioritize a guitar-focused album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Definitive Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The artist is missing, so I have no clear reason to spend time on this collection.
